brief: Clear the radiator fins of dust and pollen, clear the ventilation grilles of stacked pallets left inside the compound, and top up the conservator level. Where an ageing unit cannot be attended before an event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. On events extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, apply a further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward [MG-021].
